dynamicAllowlist.name: 7z-wasm
dynamicAllowlist.reason: Archive extraction and optional media-runtime installation resolve this package at runtime; the archive worker receives its resolved module path.

dynamicAllowlist.name: node-unrar-js
dynamicAllowlist.reason: RAR extraction loads the package and its WASM binary lazily at runtime.

unusedDependencies.name: qrcode
unusedDependencies.reason: No package import or require exists in application source or generated runtime bundles; QR login code uses the app's own network protocol and does not need a QR encoder package.

dynamicRequireAllowlist.reason: The module path is resolved in the parent process from the explicit runtime allowlist before starting the archive worker.

The script sandbox's synthetic require resolves only the app's registered JS libraries and local package modules; unknown names return an empty module and are not delegated to Node's package resolver.

licenseRetention.bundledPackageLicenseFiles: Retain license-related files from each package in the transitive dependency closure of code bundled into dist; retain only those files and their ancestor directories.

supplementalFiles.reason: The published npm package includes only the ISC identifier in package.json and omits its upstream LICENSE file.

closureLimitations: The manifest proves direct package edges from built CJS artifacts and the explicit dynamic-load allowlist. Electron Packager prune remains responsible for transitive package dependency resolution.
Runtime behavior of arbitrary downloaded JS/JAR/Python sources and native libraries is not statically enumerable; their app-owned resource roots remain included.
